title: Transit Information option (type 6) - all impls
notes: 2026-08-26 bounded all-implementation audit: NOT ready to claim/close. Spec/05-routing.md:272 requires exact Data Length 20 with a 16-byte Parent Address, and :376 assigns E to external reachability (not parent presence). Python TransitInformation supports exact 4/20 RFC forms and models E as external ownership; its production DAO path accepts E and applies the DODAGID fallback for the 4-byte form. Rust's current profile codec enforces exact 20, parent present, and flags byte exactly zero, so it rejects E=1 and cannot represent spec-required external reachability. Zephyr C is internally contradictory: lichen_rpl_transit_info_parse/write in messages.c:398-443 require/write flags=0x80 under the incorrect comment that E means parent present, but production rpl_dao_process.c:171-180 first rejects opt.data[0] != 0 and then calls that parser. Therefore no Transit option can satisfy both C checks: C-built 0x80 options are rejected before parse, while 0x00 options fail the parser. test/vectors/rpl_messages.json has no type=option / option_type=6 case despite dormant Python/Rust consumer branches, and no C shared-vector consumer exists. Excluded C/Zephyr changes are necessary, so leave open/unclaimed until E semantics are unified, the C contradiction is fixed, exact length/parent rules are enforced, and one schema-backed positive/negative corpus is independently consumed by all three. No files modified or tests run because source/vector inspection conclusively fails acceptance.
close_reason: Implemented exact type-6 Transit parity across Python/Rust/Zephyr: mandatory Data Length 20 Parent Address, correct E=external semantics, reserved-bit and malformed-length rejection, current-profile pre-mutation E rejection, shared positive/negative vectors and independent consumers. Passed Python 128 focused tests; Rust vector, DAO-origin, route-state and unit tests plus Clippy; C host vector test; pinned Zephyr v3.7 messages.c and app objects. Full pinned link remains blocked only by unrelated existing lichen_sha256 and process_dao_ex source/header mismatches.
